note: The tests build each demo with this commit of Egatari Studio (its build, runtime, checker and browser launcher). commit is a full sha and is what is fetched and checked; ref only says where it came from (a branch, or a tag in "tag"). termsCommit is the Studio commit whose tools/lint-terms.mjs and glossary tools/test-terms.mjs uses (STUDIO_TERMS_SHA overrides; the same pin as the site CI). geometryCommit is the Studio commit (v0.6.14) whose kit/core/geometry-check.mjs and kit/core/text-band.mjs tools/test-geometry.mjs runs on the demos (the pinned Studio is older than the geometry check, backlog #201).
